selector_contract.candidate_generation: variables only; no SAT truth and no exponential subset search
selector_contract.self_preserving_condition: exact DP plus cheap policy replay is terminal or the next residual remains in the AI signed-incidence class under the same frozen root budget

interpretation.what_AJ_establishes: On the frozen 15-root domain, every AJ-reachable residual lies in the AI signed-incidence class and the first admissible pivot in the frozen signed-incidence ordering is self-preserving: after exact DP and cheap policy replay the route either terminates or returns to the same class.
interpretation.notable_observation: All 122 residual events required testing exactly one candidate before finding a self-preserving pivot, despite at least 16 envelope-admissible pivots being available at every checked residual.
interpretation.what_AJ_does_not_establish: AJ is a finite inductive replay, not a universal proof that every residual reachable from arbitrary CNF belongs to the signed-incidence class or that the first admissible signed-incidence pivot is universally self-preserving. It also does not prove a polynomial SAT runtime bound.
